query:
select
to_char(registration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Registration date",
registered_by as "Registered by",
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
sex as "Sex",
ethnicity as "Ethnicity",
nationality as "Nationality",
village as "Village",
mother as "Mother",
father as "Father",
to_char(birth_time, 'HH24:MI') as "Time of birth",
gestational_age_estimate as "Gestational age (weeks)",
registered_birth_place as "Place of birth",
birth_facility as "Name of health facility (if selected)",
attendant_at_birth as "Attendant at birth",
name_of_attendant_at_birth as "Name of attendant",
birth_delivery_type as "Delivery type",
birth_type as "Single/Plural birth",
birth_weight as "Birth weight (kg)",
birth_length as "Birth length (cm)",
apgar_score_one_minute as "Apgar score at 1 min",
apgar_score_five_minutes as "Apgar score at 5 min",
apgar_score_ten_minutes as "Apgar score at 10 min"
from "reporting"."ds__births"
where
date_of_birth >= 
:fromDate
and
date_of_birth <= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:villageId is null then true
else village_id = 
:villageId
end
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else birth_facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
order by date_of_birth, birth_time
name: Registered births line list
notes: This report generates a list of all registered births for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order by date and time of birth. The report also includes key demographic information and birth details for each patient.
